title: Sliding Window API Rate Limiter

visible.label: Enforces max_requests inside sliding window per client
visible.inputDisplay: RateLimiter(2, 10): reqs at t=1, t=4 allowed; t=9 rejected; t=11 allowed (t=1 expired)
visible.script:
rl = RateLimiter(2, 10)
assert rl.allow("c1", 1) is True
assert rl.allow("c1", 4) is True
assert rl.allow("c1", 9) is False
assert rl.allow("c1", 11) is True

visible.label: Isolates separate client_id buckets
visible.inputDisplay: c1 hits cap; c2 still allowed cleanly
visible.script:
rl = RateLimiter(1, 5)
assert rl.allow("c1", 2) is True
assert rl.allow("c1", 3) is False
assert rl.allow("c2", 3) is True

hidden.label: Exact boundary timestamp - window_seconds expires old entry
hidden.inputDisplay: window=10: req at t=0 expires when t=10 arrives
hidden.script:
rl = RateLimiter(1, 10)
assert rl.allow("u", 0) is True
assert rl.allow("u", 9.99) is False
assert rl.allow("u", 10) is True

hidden.label: Rejected requests do NOT consume quota slots
hidden.inputDisplay: Denied at t=5 must not push out t=1 or keep window saturated past t=10
hidden.script:
rl = RateLimiter(1, 10)
assert rl.allow("u", 1) is True
assert rl.allow("u", 5) is False
assert rl.allow("u", 9) is False
assert rl.allow("u", 11) is True

hidden.label: Multiple identical timestamp bursts handled accurately
hidden.inputDisplay: 3 requests at exact same timestamp with limit=2
hidden.script:
rl = RateLimiter(2, 5)
assert rl.allow("x", 100) is True
assert rl.allow("x", 100) is True
assert rl.allow("x", 100) is False

hidden.label: Limit zero denies all traffic
hidden.script:
rl = RateLimiter(0, 10)
assert rl.allow("a", 1) is False

hidden.label: O(1) amortized eviction over 15,000 sequential events

hints: Keep a collections.deque per `client_id` storing accepted timestamps only.
On `allow(client_id, timestamp)`: popleft from that client deque while `q and q[0] <= timestamp - window_seconds`. If `len(q) < max_requests`, append `timestamp` and return True; else return False.

Pseudocode:
  q = self._logs[client_id]
  cutoff = timestamp - self._window
  while q and q[0] <= cutoff: q.popleft()
  if len(q) >= self._limit: return False
  q.append(timestamp); return True
